reason: Research was thin: one partial news source for the 2026-11-13 session, reporting tech and AI sharply lower, defensive and industrial sectors higher, and energy strong. That is directionally consistent with this book's value and low-vol tilt and its PSQ short. The book is +4.19% with a -2.76% max drawdown. VTV, XLF, XLE, IWD, SCHV and USMV are all positive, and PSQ is a small loss. The main drag is XLI at -5.90%, which is somewhat surprising given that industrials were reported as gaining on 11-13. That is a reason to watch it, not enough to sell into a single weak session. Gross exposure is 84.6%, with 15.36% cash. Changing the book now would add churn costs on a thin, unverified research base, so I am holding. The R2-to-R3 same-direction overlap (XLE and XLF) stays well under the 50% novelty cap.
